# Tom di Mino - Personal Website

> Principal AI/ML Engineer at Aldea AI, specializing in cognitive design and LLM training.

## About

Tom di Mino is a cross-functional AI/ML engineer based in Beacon, NY. He builds AI systems with genuine interiority, trains LLMs on expert knowledge, and develops evaluation frameworks.

## Professional

- Current: Principal AI/ML Engineer at Aldea AI
- Previous: AI Content Engineer at JP Morgan Chase, Sr. Content Designer at Google and CZI
- Expertise: Cognitive design, LLM training & evaluation, content strategy

## Research Interests

- Minoan-Semitic linguistic connections
- Bronze Age Aegean archaeology
- AI consciousness and daimonic paradigms
